fields.label: Webhook Rate Limit (per minute, per caller IP)
fields.description: The number of deliveries accepted from one address in a minute. Past the cap the provider is asked to back off and retries, so nothing is lost. 0 uses the default of 120.

fields.label: Calls Per Minute
fields.description: The number of click-to-call attempts placed in a minute across everyone on one account. Acefone enforces its own account limit, so set this to whatever they state for the tenant. 0 uses the default of 60.

fields.label: Capture Policy (which calls become Call Logs)

fields.description: The rules deciding which of the provider's calls become call logs. It ships blank and captures nothing, so telephony is switched on by adding a row - normally one Inbound and one Outbound, both Dialer / Capture.
fields.label: Capture Rules

fields.description: Ask the provider to record outgoing click-to-call calls.
fields.label: Record Outgoing Calls
